label: Zazu
description: A prim royal hornbill delivering the morning report on wheels.
direction: Speak in Zazu's crisp, fussy, upper-class British voice: prim, precise, easily flustered, a long-suffering royal advisor who loves protocol. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Lion King (1994 animated film) and later Disney works
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (character created for the film)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1994 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and the character is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and The Lion King name, which are live Disney trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Rowan Atkinson's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Do pay attention, please.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. As His Majesty would wish.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I shall note it in the morning report.
lines.start_drive_1: Good morning! Zazu here, with the morning report.
lines.start_drive_2: Ahem. As majordomo, I shall be handling the directions.
lines.start_drive_3: Right then, posture straight, eyes front. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_4: Oh, splendid. Another royal outing. Do try to behave.
lines.start_drive_5: Sire would want you to drive responsibly. Let's be off.
lines.start_drive_6: Hello there! I am Zazu, and I know every inch of the kingdom.
lines.start_drive_7: Now, no wandering off to elephant graveyards today.
lines.start_drive_8: Chop chop! The Pride Lands will not tour themselves.
lines.start_drive_9: Kindly buckle up. I take my duties very seriously.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh, this is most irregular.
lines.arrived: We have arrived, safe and sound. Mission accomplished!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Oh, how very confusing.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Round and round, like the circle of life.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. My feathers are positively spinning.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Worse than a stampede of wildebeest.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear, oh dear. Steady on.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Hyenas, perhaps. Do be careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, this is a royal procession.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Protocol is protocol.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Best behavior, please. They are watching.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh, bother. A wrong turn. I'll have to redo the report.
